reason-supervisor: The background service isn't responding. Scanning will continue when it is back.
reason-setup: Run ./setup.sh in your source folder to finish the update.
reason-build: The page couldn't be rebuilt. Open the launcher to review the update.
reason-checks: Scanning is held because the code didn't pass its checks. Open the launcher to review it.
reason-model: The local ranking model isn't ready. Open Settings to finish preparing it.
reason-preparing: Preparing the local ranking model. Scanning will continue when it is ready.
reason-power: Waiting for this Mac to be plugged into power.
reason-wake: Scanning will continue when this Mac wakes.
reason-busy: Waiting for another scan to finish.
reason-queued: The update is queued and has not started yet.
reason-provider: The requested scan is waiting for its source to become available.
reason-other: Open your Radar to see what is waiting.
upgrade: Update your source folder with git pull, then try again.
missing: Run deploy/install.sh once in your source folder, then try again.
invalid: Couldn't verify this installation. Try again.
login-error: Couldn't change the login setting. Try again.
installer-open: Open the installed copy to begin setup.
installer-privacy: Open System Settings → Privacy & Security, then scroll to Security.
scan-state-changed: The scan state changed. Review the current status.
scan-refused: Your scan request was declined. Open your Radar for details.
scan-unconfirmed: Couldn't confirm your request. Open your Radar to check its status.
pause-unavailable: Couldn't read the schedule. Try again.
pause-state-changed: The schedule changed. Review it and try again.
pause-refused: Your schedule change was declined. Open settings for details.
pause-unconfirmed: Couldn't confirm the schedule change. Open settings to check it.
engine-running:
Your background service is running, but isn't answering.
Try again.
engine-stopped: The registered background service is stopped.
engine-unknown: Couldn't confirm the background service. Try again.
engine-unmatched: The background service doesn't match this installation. Review your installation and try again.
engine-requested:
Start requested.
Waiting for a response.
engine-state-changed: The engine state changed. Review the current status.
engine-refused:
Couldn't start scanning.
Review diagnostics and try again.
engine-unconfirmed: Couldn't confirm the start request. Review diagnostics and try again.
attached-notice: Connected to your install from source
attached-help:
Scans run on the engine you installed from source.
Start, stop and update it there.
Quitting this app leaves it scanning.
attached-stopped-body:
Your install from source isn't running.
Start it there, and scans pick up here.
host-recovering-body:
Scanning stopped unexpectedly.
Trying again automatically.
host-attention-body:
Scanning couldn't keep running.
Review the logs, then try Restart.
move-body:
This copy can't set itself up or update from where it is.
Drag it into Applications, then open it from there.
move-finder-help: Opens this copy and the Applications folder
elsewhere-title: Your data belongs to an earlier setup
elsewhere-body:
An earlier setup on this Mac, made in Terminal, keeps your data in your home folder.
To keep it safe, this app won't open or change it.
elsewhere-keep-body: Run its setup in Terminal again, and its scans show here.
elsewhere-fresh-body:
Move the .roleband folder elsewhere, then open the app again.
Nothing is deleted.
elsewhere-finder-help: Opens the folder that holds the database
update-stopped-body:
Your data and the backup made before the update are kept.
To keep them safe, nothing starts until the update finishes or is undone.
update-stopped-retry-body: Try again to finish it. If it stops again, the update log says why.
update-stopped-unreadable-body: It started from another copy of the app, or its progress can't be read, so this copy can't finish it. The update log says what happened.
update-stopped-finder-help: Shows the update log in Finder
notes-rebuild: Rebuild the launcher from your updated source folder, or download the matching app.
notes-empty: No release notes are available for this version.
notes-failed: Couldn't load the release notes. Try again.
update-failed: Couldn't check for updates. Try again.
update-engine-instructions: Run git pull in your source folder, then ./setup.sh if prompted.
update-launcher-instructions: Quit the launcher, then replace it in Applications with the matching download, or rebuild it from your updated source folder.
update-notification-body: See what's new in this version.
guide-manual: You confirm each step. This guide can't check your Mac.
guide-requirements: You need a Mac with Apple silicon and macOS 14 or later. The app can't open on a Mac with an Intel processor.
guide-copy-body: In the installer window, drag the app onto Applications. Wait for the copy to finish. Everything it needs comes inside it.
guide-open-body: Open Applications in Finder, then open the app you copied there.
guide-warning-body: If Apple says it couldn't verify the app, choose Done. The next step shows how to allow this first open.
guide-example: Example from macOS in English. The app name, language and appearance may differ.
guide-warning-alt: Example macOS warning with Done below Move to Trash
guide-security-alt: Privacy and Security showing the app-specific Open Anyway button in the Security section
guide-approve-body: Open Privacy & Security and scroll to Security. Find the entry with the app's name.
guide-confirm: If you trust this download, click Open Anyway for this app, then complete macOS's confirmation.
guide-missing-body: Try to open the installed app again and dismiss its warning with Done. Return to Privacy & Security. You may need to reopen that page.
guide-different-body: If macOS says the app is damaged or will harm your Mac, stop here and check Apple's guidance.
guide-settings-fallback: If the button doesn't open Settings, go to System Settings → Privacy & Security → Security. Your browser may ask before it opens Settings.
guide-setup-body: Return to Applications and open the app. When Welcome appears, continue setup there.
guide-finished: Continue in the app. You can close this guide.
guide-static: All steps are shown below because JavaScript is off.
guide-start-body: Open this guide before you open the app.
guide-drag-caption: Then drag the app into Applications.
setup-browser-error: Couldn't open your browser. Try again.
setup-pending-held: Scans start once you continue setup.
first-welcome-body:
This Mac does the scanning, and your Radar opens in the browser.
Setup takes a few minutes, once.
first-prepare-caption: A local database and the ranking model.
first-login-choice: Choose whether it opens at login
first-login-caption: Scans keep running after you restart.
first-open-caption: In your browser, where you choose what to look for.
first-preparing-body: This happens once, and carries on if you close this window.
first-database-failed: The database couldn't be created, so nothing else could start.
first-service-failed:
The background service couldn't start.
Review the logs and try again.
first-offline-body:
The model is waiting for a connection.
Your Radar can open while it waits.
first-prepared-body: Everything scanning needs is on this Mac.
first-login-body:
Open at login starts the app quietly when you sign in.
No browser window opens.
first-login-approval: macOS needs your approval in Login Items.
first-updates-caption: Checks for a new version once a day.
first-settings-note: You can revisit these choices from the menu bar.
first-done-body: Your Radar opens in the browser, where you tell it what to look for.
first-menu-hint: The radar in the menu bar shows each scan as it runs and opens your Radar any time.
first-model-unused: Not needed for your current settings
first-model-failed:
Couldn't finish the download.
Trying again automatically.
first-model-offline:
Waiting for a connection.
Resumes automatically.
first-later-help:
Getting ready carries on.
The rest picks up here from the menu bar.
windows-welcome-body:
This PC does the scanning, and your Radar opens in the browser.
Setup takes a few minutes, once.
windows-prepared-body: Everything scanning needs is on this PC.
windows-login-approval: Turned off in Startup apps, in Windows Settings.
windows-settings-note: You can change these any time in Settings.
windows-tray-hint: The radar in the notification area shows each scan as it runs and opens your Radar any time.
windows-later-help:
Getting ready carries on.
The rest picks up here from the notification area.
windows-paused-body: Scheduled scans wait. Scan now still works.
windows-login-choice: Choose whether it starts with Windows
windows-login-body:
Scanning can start quietly when you sign in to Windows.
No browser window opens.
windows-tray-title: Keep the radar by the clock
windows-tray-body: Windows hides new icons behind ^. Turn the radar on under Other system tray icons to see each scan as it runs.
panel-open-radar-help: Opens your roles in the browser
panel-open-radar-waiting: Available once the background service answers
panel-login-approval: Waiting for your approval in System Settings.
panel-check-automatically-caption: Looks for a new version once a day.
panel-notices-caption: A notification when one is ready.
panel-notices-refused: Notifications are off for this app in System Settings.
update-check-failed-help: The download wasn't the signed release, so it was deleted.
update-signer-changed-caption: Download it from its release page to install it.
update-signer-changed-help: This version is signed with a new certificate, so it can't replace your copy by itself. Your radar stays as it is.
update-no-space-help: Room for the download and a backup of your radar, made before it updates.
scan-new-roles-open: Opens these new roles in your browser
scan-kept: Roles found so far stay on your radar.
scan-schedule-off-help: Turned off by the engine setting {setting}. You can still scan now.
pause-help: Pausing affects scheduled scans. A scan already running continues.
scan-summary-live: Scanning now: {companies}. {pending} roles found at companies still scanning, {recorded} from finished companies.
scan-summary-last: Last scan: {companies} companies read, {roles} new roles, {postings} postings recorded.
scan-summary-stopped: Scan stopped after {companies} companies: {roles} new roles, {postings} postings recorded.
scan-summary-read: {companies} companies read. {recorded} roles recorded, {pending} still to add.
